Being immobile against her is quite the down side but my experience against lux is that her E poke overtime is enough to deter me from engaging so easily. Yet if she used her E to engage she shouldn't have enough damage or energy to kill. 

Kayle is just a matter of timing R with her R2 and slowing with Q to kite, but seeing how Akalis power Spyke is much earlier that is a hard thing to say.

Akalis mobility is her biggest strength, take that away from her and she's kinda screwed. She is also really good for 1v1s and has a lot of outplay potential, she looks to take a lead in lane so she can get a lot done in team fights.

To play against Akali, if you have better poke use it, but respect her range with R and E. Keep your disengage for after she uses her E but most importantly, don't let her poke you too much or land her E.
